props.title: Aeon's Identity Layer Now Writes Itself

props.text: most frameworks let you configure behavior. this week aeon made you configure *who the agent is* — and generates it for you. soul-builder reads your X, strategy-builder reads your goal, out come SOUL.md (voice) + STRATEGY.md (north-star). 7 PRs, both wired into every skill.
a fork that argues in your voice and chases your metric before you write a line of skill code. different product.
